# Mohammad Shihab Hossain - Professional Profile & Knowledge Base

> Aspiring AI & Software Developer | Computer Science Student at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB)

## Overview
Mohammad Shihab Hossain (also known as Shihab Hossain, Md. Shihab Hossain, Md Shihab) is a Computer Science student, Software Developer, and AI researcher. He specializes in full-stack web development, machine learning, data science, and critical infrastructure cybersecurity.

## Core Expertise & Skills
- **Programming Languages**: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Bash
- **Web Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, Supabase, Firebase
- **AI / Data Science & ML**: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Statistical Analysis, Data Visualization
- **Tools & DevOps**: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux/Unix, Shell Scripting, Genkit, Tiptap, Vitest

## Key Achievements & Recognitions
- **Dean’s Award for Academic Excellence** — Fall 2024–2025 (AIUB)
- **Dean’s Award for Academic Excellence** — Spring 2024–2025 (AIUB)
- **1st Place in Project Display** — Notre Dame Science Club (Mar 2022)
- **1st Place in Project Display** — Govt. Science College Science Club (Jan 2022)
- **3rd Place in Web Designing** — Notre Dame Science Club (Mar 2022)
- **IEOM 7th Bangladeshi International Conference Presentation Recognition** — IEOM Society International (Dec 2024)
- **Certified Certifications**: OPSWAT ICIP, HackerRank Certified Python Developer, HackerRank Certified JavaScript Developer, IBM Blockchain Foundation V2, Cisco Cybersecurity Essentials, TryHackMe Advent of Cyber.

## Research & Publications
- Conference presentations & publications in international proceedings (IEOM Society International).
- Focus areas: Applied AI in industrial engineering, system optimization, software reliability, and cybersecurity.
